configurations.name: viberr-dev
runtimeArgs: if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^viberr-app-1$'; then echo 'REFUSED: viberr-app-1 is running on docker-data, and SQLite WAL over a bind mount tolerates ONE writer per data root (host+container dual writers have eaten PATs and run logs before). Stop the container first, or use viberr-dev-hermetic.'; exit 1; fi; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use >/dev/null 2>&1; export VIBERR_DATA_ROOT=/Users/akinozer/projects/viberr/docker-data; exec npm run dev

configurations.name: viberr-dev-hermetic
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use >/dev/null 2>&1; export VIBERR_DATA_ROOT="$PWD/data"; export PORT=5174; exec npm run dev -- --port 5174
